sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.2401 of 2016
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue,
learned Standing Counsel for Central Government for the respondent Nos.5 and 7 and perused the entire material on record.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the respondents are interfering into the possession and enjoyment of the petitioner over the land Ac.0.50 cents (equivalent to Ac.0.20 gts.,)
which consists of residential house bearing H.No.6-64 and well in Sy.No.17/27, Pulikunta Village,
Rebbena Mandal, Adilabad District, without issuing any notification and without following the process of law prescribed under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, "the Act, 2013").
3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue for the respondent No.4 basing on counter submits that as per the averments made in paragraph No.2 it is stated that the land in Sy.No.17/27 situated at Pulikunta Village of Rebbena Mandal, Adilabad District was not at all acquired and the petitioner is residing in his own house bearing No.6-64 and no disturbance has been caused to his well in Sy.No.17/27, hence the issue of notification and following the due process under the Act,
2013 does not arise.
4.

In view of the submissions made by both sides, the writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the property of the petitioner, without following due process of law.
If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they have to follow the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: There shall be no order as to costs.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any in this petition, shall stand closed.
